title: Living at 512 Dolphin Street, wharf work and pension
summary: Tom lists his addresses, who he played with while living on Dolphin Street including Love, and talks about wharf and banana work and being denied a pension.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music
